annotations.title: Pick photos for a photo book

description: Use this when someone wants to make a printed photo book (Dutch: fotoboek) or photo album but has not shared any photos yet. Shows a card where they pick the photos, in order, right here. Nothing is ordered or charged.

language.description: Two-letter code of the language the person writes in, such as nl or en.
